en: A black‑and‑white multi‑view postcard with four photographs of a German town. The upper left shows a church tower with multiple spires rising above tiled rooftops. The upper right and lower left images depict rows of mid‑20th‑century apartment blocks labeled as new buildings on Otto‑Buchwitz‑Straße. The lower right image shows a historic town hall with a tower and ornate roof. In the center there is a title panel with the town's name.
